annotation.title_clean: ROBOGATE: Adaptive Failure Discovery for Safe Robot Policy Deployment via Two-Stage Boundary-Focused Sampling
annotation.title_en: ROBOGATE: Adaptive Failure Discovery for Safe Robot Policy Deployment via Two-Stage Boundary-Focused Sampling
annotation.summary_en: arXiv preprint presenting ROBOGATE, an open-source pre-deployment risk validation framework for learned robot manipulation policies. It uses two-stage adaptive sampling in Isaac Sim to find failure boundaries across four robot arms and benchmarks VLA policies, showing a large cross-simulator gap (97.65% to 0%).
key_provisions_or_claims: Two-stage sampling (LHS then boundary-focused) finds failure boundaries over an 8-dimensional parameter space.
Over 50,000 simulated experiments across Franka Panda, UR3e, UR5e and UR10e.
Logistic regression risk model achieves AUC 0.780 and yields a closed-form failure boundary.
A fine-tuned GR00T N1.6 scores 97.65% on LIBERO but 0% on 68 industrial scenarios in Isaac Sim.
Proposes a validation layer for Physical AI deployment.
